_comment: Shared Markdown section cases, read by internal/md (splitBySections over goldmark's output) and extension/src/md.js (parseMarkdown over marked's). sections lists each section's opening heading, "" for text before the first one. Only a top-level <h1>/<h2> opens a section: one inside a blockquote or a list belongs to that block (audit finding E26). See docs/PARITY.md, Markdown sections.
